recalled_knowledge.item: asymptotic Z = sqrt(q0) for a one-sided test of a single parameter of interest (Wilks/Chernoff)
one-sided 95 % profile-likelihood upper limit at Delta(2 ln L) = 2.71
p_global = 1 - (1 - p_local)^N_eff for N_eff effective independent trials (Sidak form)
a log-normal prior is the standard model of a multiplicative (factor) uncertainty on a rate

failed_or_abandoned: New background-only toys per deformation: ~50 ms/toy in P052's loop gives only ~4000 toys in the 4-minute budget (4 exceedances at p ~ 1e-3), too coarse for 0.1-sigma shifts; P052's measured toy offset (-0.08 sigma) and P071's N_eff mapping used instead
Common MSSI parameter tied to the RFR sideband bins as well: rejected (RFR is 2 % of the FV expectation; RFR treated with its own six bins)
Digitising Fig. S4 to count prompt-veto events at S1c > 500 phd in the band: not attempted; the predicted 0.11 events at g_max show it would be uninformative
Own simplified-cylinder annulus/FV ratio: thin-annulus estimate reproduces 6.25 at 1.23 cm but gives 0.74 vs P079's 0.86 at 4.3 cm (z extension of the 5.4 t volume); P079's contour integrals used
